sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XVIII — Elevator Requirements
sources.description: Governs elevator design, installation, and safety requirements for Philippine buildings. Mandates elevators based on building height and occupancy.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Table 1206-A — Occupant Load Calculation
sources.description: Used to determine required number of elevators based on building occupancy load and type.

sources.label: Section 3206 — Elevator Safety Requirements (ASME A17.1/CSA B44 referenced)
sources.description: Philippine code references ASME A17.1 for elevator safety standards including car dimensions, door sizes, and emergency systems.
